about_the_game:
Created by a two-person team. Join our "World Observatory" QQ Group to chat with us!

QQ Group Number:935818626

Game Synopsis
<FUSHA2 Nocturnal Fishing> is a horror adventure game that delivers a breakneck pace and rich content. Utilizing realistic 3D environments, over fifty haunting hand-drawn CGs, and a refined 20,000-word script, it cuts out all tedious exposition to immerse you in the terror of being alone in an unfamiliar and dire situation, facing an escalating survival crisis.

Note: This is a pure text-based novel game with no action sequences.

Branching Narrative & Endings
Venturing alone to a secluded river bend at night, hoping for a big catch, your every casual choice will steer the story in different directions. Encounter unforeseen events and discover over twenty different endings. Among them, only one path leads to survival. Will you be lucky enough to make the right choices?

No Jumpscares
Tired of sudden loud noises and things popping into your face? Rest assured, this game avoids such heart-stopping tactics.<FUSHA2 Nocturnal Fishing> is more like a classic horror film. It never relies on cheap jumpscares, yet masterfully maintains a deeply unsettling atmosphere that sends chills down your spine, fully committing to an immersive experience.

Future Plans
While <FUSHA2 Nocturnal Fishing> is a complete story in itself, it also serves as the second chapter in the planned six-part <FUSHAS> saga. The hidden threads connecting the larger narrative are gradually being revealed. In future installments, we will continue to deliver uniquely styled horror stories, each offering a distinctively different experience.

Recommendation
Ideal for players who enjoy text-based novels or horror, seeking a casual yet thrilling experience. Also makes for a unique gift for friends!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some violent, bloody, and body-damaging scenes
